features.title: Read-only mode in the command gate
features.user_visible_behavior: With HARNESS_GATE_MODE=readonly, only read commands pass the gate; writes, redirections, substitutions and overrides are denied.
features.evidence: 2026-11-17: command-gate.test.mjs 9/9 incl. 3 po-readonly-gate tests (14 reads allowed, 23 write paths denied incl. redirections, sed -i, git commit, node -e, $( ), find -delete, intake without --dry-run; override ignored; hook denies for Claude and allows reads for Cursor); kit vendor --check OK.

features.title: Tell the PO session to use read-only mode
features.user_visible_behavior: The shaping agent, Play O and the Claude runtime README tell the PO/PM session to set HARNESS_GATE_MODE=readonly.
verification: grep -q HARNESS_GATE_MODE=readonly cli/agents/asdd-shaping-agent.md && grep -q HARNESS_GATE_MODE=readonly docs/PLAYBOOK.md && grep -q HARNESS_GATE_MODE=readonly cli/runtimes/claude/README.md
features.evidence: 2026-11-17: HARNESS_GATE_MODE=readonly in shaping agent, PLAYBOOK Play O (gap note replaced) and Claude runtime README; agents-lint PASS; npm test 252/252.
